name: stock-alarm
description: Stock Alarm (SA) mod: a boxed watchlist table docked above the prompt (or a live one-line ticker strip), a /sa watchlist pane, local price alerts, and /sa commands to add, remove, dock, and open symbols on Stock Alarm Pro (pro.stockalarm.io). Quotes come from Stock Alarm's public tickers feed.

watchlist.title: Default watchlist
watchlist.description: Space- or comma-separated symbols used until you change the list with /sa add or /sa rm

quote_endpoint.title: Quote endpoint
quote_endpoint.description: Optional URL template for quotes. Use {symbol} for one request per symbol or {symbols} for one bulk request. Empty means Stock Alarm's public tickers feed. The SA_QUOTE_ENDPOINT environment variable overrides this.

display.title: Where to show the watchlist
display.description: panel: a boxed watchlist table docked above the prompt (folds to the one-line ticker strip when the terminal is under 30 rows or 60 columns). band: just the one-line strip above the prompt. status: one line under the prompt. off: only the /sa pane. /sa dock and /sa undock override this.

panel_rows.title: Docked table rows
panel_rows.description: How many symbols the docked table shows (triggered alarms first). /sa dock N overrides this.
